title: every class with code in learning_block reaches the diagnostic mixin
intention: Every class with code in learning_block reaches DiagnosticBase: DoorRefused take it as their first base, so each can run a diagnostic report when we need it, and each behaves as before.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-every-class-reaches-the-diagnostic-mixin naming DoorRefused in learning_block. Akien, 2026-10-27 (ticket 339a45cee6a1): "any class with code it in should be able to run a diagnostic report when we need it".
how: Import DiagnosticBase from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic in cairn/machines/learning_block/learning_block.py and make it the first base of DoorRefused, keeping every other base. Prove it with cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_every_learning_block_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve returns [] for component learning_block at cairn/machines/learning_block
DoorRefused each subclass DiagnosticBase, keep their original base, and behave as before

decisions.text: D1: DiagnosticBase goes first among the bases, as 668c8d64b4e2 and b13c53dd679c did; the import sits at module level beside the others; nothing else in the class changes.
